text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a deprecation for the legacy `X-Redwood-Auth` header used by some marketplace partners. Thinking: announce now, deprecate in 6 weeks, turn off in 12 weeks. Need partner comms plan, SI integrators notified, and SDK patches ready. :warning:

Samir Patel: +1 on timeline. Are we shipping a compatibility shim in SDKs or forcing server-side fallback? We should avoid breaking partner infra. Suggest: SDKs v3.1 add `enable_legacy_auth` flag and emit deprecation warnings. Also we should update semver notes.

Ana Gomez: runtime can accept both headers for a fallback period, we just need tests and a canary. Suggest canary in Dedicated + Marketplace listings for 2 weeks before global flip. We'll need a feature flag name (propose `legacy_auth_fallback`) and a rollout plan.

Liam O'Reilly: sounds good. I'll own partner comms. Plan: 1) personalized emails for top-10 partners, 2) public marketplace announcement + migration guide, 3) SI integrator call for critical flows. Need list of impacted partners and dev contacts. Maya, can you surface that? :clipboard:

Maya Chen: yes — I'll pull the impacted partner list from the CRM and tag top-10. Also, we'll add a migration checklist in the docs and a short FAQ. Who can write the migration snippet for the README?

Samir Patel: I can draft snippets for JS and Python. Quick PSR for the header change: old header `X-Redwood-Auth` -> new header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Example migration CLI:```bash
# replace old header with new one
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' https://api.redwood.example/generate
```I'll push examples to the sdk-migrations repo.

Ana Gomez: ack. We'll add automated tests to the e2e suite to validate both headers during the canary. Also need to update tracing so we can filter legacy auth hits (`tag:legacy_auth=true`). Ops, add observability tickets?

Maya Chen: yes please open an observability ticket (assign to eng-sre). Liam — can you confirm legal notice period? Partners in EEA may need 30 days minimum. If legal needs >6 weeks, we shift timeline.

Liam O'Reilly: pinged Legal. Early feedback: 30-day notice should be fine; we'll aim for 6 weeks to give partners time. I'll draft the partner email and share the template here for review.

DeployBot: [automated] Canaries scheduled: marketplace-canary-01 (start: 1748200000) — notification queued.

Samir Patel: one more thing — propose a small telemetry opt-in so we can detect un-upgraded clients that keep sending `X-Redwood-Auth`. Add header echo `X-Legacy-Auth-Detected: 1` in responses during deprecation window. That’ll help partners find callers.

Ana Gomez: +1, easy to add server-side. We'll also expose a per-partner breakdown in Console under 'SDK Health' → 'Legacy Auth usage'.

Maya Chen: sweet. Action items: Samir: SDK snippets + releases; Ana: canary + tests + observability; Liam: partner comms + legal check; Maya: partner list + docs checklist. I'll run 1:1s with top-5 tomorrow. :calendar:

Samir Patel: noted, I'll prep PRs and a changelog entry.

Ana Gomez: will open tickets and assign.

Liam O'Reilly: drafting email now, will share for review in ~2h.

Maya Chen: thanks all — let's aim to have the public migration guide live by EOD Friday and a draft partner email by EOD today. :thumbsup:
